pages.text: Use on a patient, or in the air on yourself, to name the sickness and how far along it is.
$(l)Lancing$() severe buboes knocks Bubonic Plague back a stage. It hurts, but never below a heart.

pages.title: Leeches
pages.text: Fill a bottle in a $(l)swamp$() and you may bring up a jar of leeches. Bloodletting draws $(l)Septicemic Plague$() back a stage (and cures it in the first). On anyone else they only feed.
Light a $(l)Censer$() and carry it: it burns dried herbs, and its smoke shields you and anyone within four blocks from coughs and miasma.
